sentences.text: Heard Shri Arun Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for the applicants, Shri B.B. Upadhyay, learned counsel for the State and perused the material brought on record.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants-Vishal Upadhyay and Smt. Suresh Bala with the prayer to stay the order dated 6.1.2023 by which non-bailable warrant has been issued against the applicants in Criminal Case No.14563 of 2020 (State Vs. Vishal Upadhyay and another) U/s 498-A, 323, 504, 506 IPC read with Section 3/4 D.P. Act, arising out of Case Crime No.352 of 2019, P.S. Babupurva, District Kanpur Nagar pending before Metropolitan Magistrate, Court No.9, Kanpur Nagar.

sentences.text:
At the very outset it is brought to the notice of the Court that as per the report of the stamp reporter,
a previous application being Criminal Misc. Application U/S 482 No.4075 of 2021 by the same applicants has been filed.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Application U/S 482 No.4075 of 2021
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: List of fresh cases shows the status of the same to be disposed of.

On being countered, learned counsel for the applicants has produced an order dated 2.12.2021 passed by coordinate Bench of this Court in Criminal Misc. Application U/S 482 No.4075 of 2021,
Vishal Upadhyay and another Vs. State of U.P. and another which is taken on record.

entities.text: Vishal Upadhyay and another Vs. State of U.P. and another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicants states that he has no information about the filing of the previous application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. and has not been instructed by the applicants and even the deponent Vishal Upadhyay who is the applicant no.1 about the same.

He states that looking to the fact that the applicants have previously approached this Court for quashing of the impugned order as well as entire proceedings of the case, the present application be dismissed as withdrawn.
Learned counsel for the State has serious objections for the same.

After hearing the learned counsel for the parties and perusing the records, it is evident that the applicants have preferred Criminal Misc. Application U/S 482 No. 4075 of 2021, Vishal Upadhyay and another Vs. State of U.P. and another which stood disposed of vide order dated 2.12.2021 passed by coordinate Bench of this Court.

entities.text: Vishal Upadhyay and another Vs. State of U.P. and another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As the learned counsel had given up the prayer for challenging the judgement and order, entire proceedings of the case and had requested the said Court to pass an order directing the courts below to decide the bail application of the applicants expeditiously, the said petition was disposed of with the direction to decide the bail application expeditiously.

The said order reads as follows:-
"Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants with the prayer to quash the order dated 14.09.2020 as well as entire criminal proceedings of Criminal Case No.15463 of 2020 (State Vs. Vishal Upadhyay and another), arising out of Case Crime No.352 of 2019, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. read with Section 3/4 of the D.P. Act, P.S. Kanpur Nagar, District- Kanpur Nagar pending in the court of A.C.M.M., II Kanpur.

entities.text: Criminal Case No.15463 of 2020 (State Vs. Vishal Upadhyay and another)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As per the allegations made in the first information report, it is alleged that the applicant no.1 was married to opposite party no.2 on 02.05.2019, however, after the said marriage, the applicants started making demand of additional dowry and for non-fulfillment of dowry, they tortured her, maltreated her and subjected her to cruelty and turned her out from her matrimonial home.

Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that from perusal of the allegations made in the FIR and the material collected during the course of investigation, no offence is disclosed against the applicants and the present case has been instituted with a malafide intention for the purpose of harassment.

He has pointed out certain Vishal Upadhyay And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118647183/
2 documents and statements in support of his contention, as such, entire proceedings be quashed.

entities.text: Vishal Upadhyay And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned AGA has submitted that from perusal of the allegations made in the FIR and the material collected during the course of investigation, prima facie offence is clearly made out against the applicants, as such, impugned order as well as entire proceedings cannot be quashed.
From perusal of the material on record and looking into the facts of the case, at this stage, it cannot be said that no offence is made out against the applicants.

Moreover,
all the submissions made at the bar relates to the disputed question of fact, which cannot be adjudicated upon by this Court under Section 482 CrPC.

At this stage, only prima facie case is to be seen in the light of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the cases of R.P. Kapur Vs. State of Punjab, AIR 1960 SC 866, State of Haryana Vs. Bhajan Lal, 1992 SCC (Cri.) 426, State of Bihar Vs. P.P. Sharma, 1992 SCC (Cri.) 192 and lastly Zandu Pharmaceutical Works Ltd. Vs. Mohd. Saraful Haq and another, (Para-10) 2005 SCC (Cri.) 283.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The disputed defence of the accused cannot be considered at this stage.
The prayer for quashing the impugned order as well as entire proceedings is therefore refused.
However, it is directed that if the applicants appear/surrender before the court below and apply for bail, their prayer for bail be considered and disposed of expeditiously in accordance with law.
With the aforesaid observations, this application under Section 482 CrPC is finally disposed of. "
Now the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed challenging the impugned order passed in the said case.
The same is a repeat petition.
The affidavit in the present application has been sworn by Vishal Upadhyay who is the applicant no.1 herein and was even the applicant no.1 in the previous application under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
There is no disclosure of the previous application but to the contrary there is a concealment of filing of the previous application.

In view of the same, it is apparent that the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with concealment of relevant and vital fact that the applicants have previously approached this Court by filing earlier Criminal Misc. Application U/S 482 No.4075 of 2021 which stood disposed of by order dated 2.12.2021.
Even there is no disclosure as to whether the said order has been complied with or not.
The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is a repeat application with the same prayers without any change of circumstances.
The applicants have not approached this Court with clean hands.
In view of the same this is a case which is clearly a misuse of process of Court.

The prayer for Vishal Upadhyay And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118647183/
3 dismissing the present petition as withdrawn is turned down.

entities.text: Vishal Upadhyay And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Thus the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is dismissed with a cost of Rs.25,000/-
which shall be deposited by the applicants of the present case within one month from today before the Registrar General of this Court for its utilization by the High Court Legal Service Committee to which it shall be transferred.

If the cost is not deposited within the said time, the District Magistrate/Collector concerned be directed to recover it as land revenue arrears forthwith and transmit it to this Court for its utilisation as above.
